test_title: PYST 50: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 8th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Demolish
solution:
The solution is **Construct**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate ANTONYM of "**Demolish**" is Construct.

 
 
• **Demolish** - Pull or knock down a building.__
 
• __**Construct** - Build or make something, typically a building, road, or machine.__
 
• Divide - Separate or be separated into parts.
 
• Diminish - Make or become less.
 
• Destroy - End the existence of something by damaging or attacking it.
 
 
 
• Therefore **option 2 **is the correct option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Antonym - Antonym is the opposite meaning of the given word.

 
 
• Antonym of **Divide **is join.
 
• Antonym of **Diminish **is increase.
 
• Antonym of **Destroy **is built.
